category_edits.rationale: Average the existing BPR plus 0.2 pointwise loss within each sampled user's valid positions, then across users. Equal user weighting may better align training with user-averaged HR@10 across all four datasets. Model and predictor shapes remain unchanged.

edits.find:
loss = pairwise_loss + 0.2 * pointwise_loss
    return (loss * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)
edits.replace:
loss = pairwise_loss + 0.2 * pointwise_loss
    valid_counts = mask.sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1.0)
    user_losses = (loss * mask).sum(dim=1) / valid_counts
    return user_losses.mean()
